name: app-dark-spending-overview-card-over-photo-beside-hand-held-cards-screen
title: Spending Overview Card and Card Fan Screen
whatItIs: A split image: at left a man on a sofa with a dark frosted card overlay showing monthly spend and a ring chart of transactions; at right a hand-held phone showing 'Manage Your Cards' with a fan of pearlescent cards and action icons.
whatItMeans: Pairing a human moment with UI cards ties numbers to life, and the pearl card fan feels premium.
techniques: Dark frosted card overlaid on a lifestyle photo
Ring chart with a pearl gradient stroke
Fan of cards as the hero of the screen
Two equal panels side by side

vocabulary.definition: Two related images shown side by side.
A circular chart showing a value in a ring.
